forWhat: The school's classes: each one's grade, the children in it and who teaches it. The coordinator moves a child from here.

layout.shows: Grade, and a search for a class or an educator.
Class, Grade, Children and Educators. Press a class to open its children below.
Each child's Sr. No. and name, since when, and where from, with a [[Move]] button on each row.
Every move of a child in or out of the class: Sr. No., from, to, who and when.

jobs.title: See who teaches a class
steps: Find the class in the table. [[Educators]] names who holds it today.

jobs.title: Move a child to another class
steps: Press the class, then press [[Move]] on the child's row.
Choose the class they go to, the Sr. No. they will have there and the date they start. Press [[Save the move]].
The child is in the new class from that date. Their answers and results stay with them, and the move is kept in the change log.

buttons.label: Move
buttons.does: Opens a small form for the new class, Sr. No. and date.
buttons.doesNot: It does not move anyone until you press Save the move.

buttons.label: Save the move
buttons.does: Closes the child's place in the old class, opens one in the new class and writes the change log.
buttons.doesNot: It does not delete anything the child has done.
